comparison.objective: Raise, rotate, and relock a spring-indexed monitor; candidate finishes installed thread inserts by breaking off tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Large articulated load adjustment and spring-lock engagement versus millimetre-scale coaxial tool stabilization and impact regulation.
comparison.success_condition: Specified lift and rotation, preserved tilt, relocking, collision avoidance, and 20 seconds hands-off versus four fractures and recovered fragments without insert or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Both are bimanual and force-sensitive, but their mechanisms and tested abilities are materially different.
